SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2 FROM KEP.ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'IV_DOWN' AND TARGET = 'KRDONG0595' AND TRIM(KEY_10) IS NULL
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT nvl(trim(PODT.PLANT),'100') AS MANDT ,GRDT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS EBELN ,GRDT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS EBELP ,GRDT.INV_NO AS INV_NO ,GRDT.INV_SEQ AS INV_SEQ ,(select count(*) from KEP.icomivdt where status ^= 'D' and buyer = ivdt.buyer and po_no = ivdt.po_no and po_seq= ivdt.po_seq and add_date||add_time < ivdt.add_date||ivdt.add_time) + 1 AS PARTIAL_NO ,to_char(to_date(IVDT.INVOICE_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DEL_DATE ,GRDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATNR ,GRDT.ITEM_QTY AS MENGE ,trim(substrb(GRDT.UNIT_MEASURE,1,3)) AS MEINS ,PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS NETPR ,DECODE(PODT.ITEM_QTY,GRDT.ITEM_QTY,'N','Y') AS PARTIAL_DEL ,GRDT.ITEM_QTY AS DEL_QTY ,PODT.ITEM_QTY - PODT.IV_QTY AS REMAIN_QTY ,0 AS GR_QTY ,'C' AS STATUS FROM KEP.ICOMGRDT GRDT, KEP.ICOMPODT PODT, KEP.ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE GRDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND GRDT.GR_NO = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND GRDT.GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND GRDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND GRDT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ= IVDT.PO_SEQ AND GRDT.INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND GRDT.INV_SEQ= IVDT.INV_SEQ UNION ALl SELECT nvl(trim(PODT.PLANT),'100') AS MANDT ,GRDT.LEGACY_PO_NO AS EBELN ,GRDT.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS EBELP ,GRDT.INV_NO AS INV_NO ,GRDT.INV_SEQ AS INV_SEQ ,(select count(*) from KEP.wmsivdt where status ^= 'D' and buyer = ivdt.buyer and po_no = ivdt.po_no and po_seq= ivdt.po_seq and add_date||add_time < ivdt.add_date||ivdt.add_time) + 1 AS PARTIAL_NO ,to_char(to_date(IVDT.INV_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DEL_DATE ,GRDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MATNR ,GRDT.ITEM_QTY AS MENGE ,trim(substrb(GRDT.UNIT_MEASURE,1,3)) AS MEINS ,PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS NETPR ,DECODE(PODT.ITEM_QTY,GRDT.ITEM_QTY,'N','Y') AS PARTIAL_DEL ,GRDT.ITEM_QTY AS DEL_QTY ,PODT.ITEM_QTY - PODT.IV_QTY AS REMAIN_QTY ,0 AS GR_QTY ,'C' AS STATUS FROM KEP.ICOMGRDT GRDT, KEP.ICOMPODT PODT, KEP.WMSIVDT IVDT WHERE GRDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND GRDT.GR_NO = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND GRDT.GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND GRDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND GRDT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ= IVDT.PO_SEQ AND GRDT.INV_NO = IVDT.INV_NO AND GRDT.INV_SEQ= IVDT.INV_SEQ ORDER BY INV_NO, INV_SEQ
UPDATE KEP.ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'Y' ,KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'IV_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND TRIM(KEY_10) IS NULL
UPDATE KEP.ICOMTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'E' ,KEY_9 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'IV_DOWN' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND TRIM(KEY_10) IS NULL
